title: GPT-6 Sol Is Now Available on Emergent
summary: GPT-6 Sol is now available on Emergent. Build full-stack apps on OpenAI's cost-efficient agentic model via the Universal LLM Key, at 50% lower token prices.
body_markdown:
GPT-6 Sol, OpenAI's new cost-efficient model for coding and agentic work, is now available on Emergent. You can use it to build full-stack apps by describing what you want, with no separate OpenAI account and no API keys to manage. Sol runs through the Universal LLM Key alongside Claude and Gemini, billed from your Emergent Credits.


The headline is cost. At launch,[OpenAI](https://emergent.sh/learn/what-is-openai) priced Sol at $2 per 1M input tokens and $10 per 1M output tokens, half its previous generation's rate, and built it for sustained agent work. On Emergent, that lower cost per task means more affordable agentic features in the apps you ship.


## What GPT-6 Sol brings to your builds


GPT-6 Sol is OpenAI's mid-tier model, built for complex coding and agentic workflows at a fraction of flagship Astra's cost. It handles text and image input, returns text, and carries a 1.05 million-token context window with an April 20, 2026 knowledge cutoff.


The benchmark story is score per dollar. In[OpenAI's own tests](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna/) , Sol scores 33.2% on AutomationBench, a test of business workflows across 47 tools, and 68.8% on the DeepSWE v1.1 coding benchmark, both at a low cost per task. On the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, it scores 48 at maximum reasoning effort. For most agentic and business-automation work, that combination makes Sol a strong default.


## How to build with GPT-6 Sol on Emergent


You select GPT-6 Sol from the model selector on Emergent, so switching to it takes a single step. From there, your agent uses Sol to build whatever you describe.


You can also manage active models yourself in Account Settings, under the Universal Key's LLM Providers. Either way, usage draws from your Emergent Credits with one unified bill, so there are no separate accounts to create for OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.


## What changes for your builds


Sol's low cost per task makes agentic features cheaper to run at scale. Use it as the workhorse behind chatbots, automations, document tools, and internal apps, where it handles multi-step reasoning and tool calls without a heavy per-task bill.


For the rare step that needs peak reasoning, the Universal LLM Key lets you route that call to a frontier model like Claude Opus 5.5 or GPT-6 Astra, then drop back to Sol. You choose the model per job, not per project.


## Start building with GPT-6 Sol


GPT-6 Sol widens what you can build affordably on Emergent, from a quick internal tool to a production-grade app with real users. Pick the model that fits each step, describe what you want, and let Emergent's multi-agent architecture build, test, and deploy it.


[Start Building on Emergent](https://emergent.sh/) and put GPT-6 Sol to work on your next project.
